headline: 橫跨大陸的單車愛情故事
context: 有一部新紀錄片，講一段瑞典與印度跨國戀情，男主角曾經靠一趟橫跨約六千英里的單車旅程追到對方。片子由一位奧斯卡得獎導演執導，起點據說源自一次星座配對的緣分。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: One Oscar-winning director, one horoscope-prompted meet-cute and a continent-crossing cyclist – is this the start of documentaries that make you happy-cry? Here is a story that on the face of it seems so wildly unlikely it can only be true. Indeed, the very concept of a romantic documentary sounds almost oxymoronic, an indication of how much nonfiction films have become synonymous with grim histories full of suffering and injustice. Let’s hope this sweet work, directed by Orlando von Einsiedel (who’s made his share of hardcore, suffering-intensive docs including Oscar-winning short The White Helmets) launches a new trend in nonfiction film-making for stuff that makes you happy-cry. The basic meet-cute happened in 1975, when PK (played by Chirag Lobo in the film’s extensive re-enactments) met Lotta (Mina Dale) in Delhi. He was a poor street artist, a Dalit, the lowest possible caste, once called Untouchables. The real PK Mahanandia appears on screen to explain how he had left his rural village for Delhi in order to get away from all that caste hierarchy. When he met Lotta he pretty much knew he’d met the woman of his dreams because he’d been carrying a horoscope his father had commissioned for him when he was a baby that prophesised he’d fall in love with a woman whose family owned a jungle. Lotta, a backpacker from Sweden, hailed from a clan back home that owned a forest, so that was good enough for PK to believe he’d met his fate. After a chaste holiday romance bloomed between these two crazy kids, she went back to Sweden and he decided to bicycle the 6,000 miles all the way there from India to prove his love. thread_text:
橫跨大陸的單車愛情故事

新紀錄片《The Cycle of Love》，記錄一對瑞典與印度跨國戀人的故事：男主角當年為了追對方，騎了一趟大約六千英里的單車長征。片子由一位奧斯卡得獎導演執導，起點據說是一次星座占卜牽的線。

—— 本則來自 Guardian，2026 年 9 月 16 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
